audit.whatIsWrong: Page reads EVEN with Irelia holding 6 of 7 chart stages, but the matchup is 47.2% over 2303 games.
audit.why: Sylas out-ranges Irelia in lane (Chain Lash 775 vs Bladesurge 600), heals chip with Kingslayer (12/10.5/9/7.5/6s), and takes Vanguard's Edge with Hijack at 6. Irelia's real edge is the level-3 Flawless Duet window.
audit.corrected: Chart moved to Sylas at levels 1-2, Irelia at 3, even at 4-5 and first item, Sylas at 6 and 2+ items; sides and win[] paired.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes credited Irelia at 6 and first item with no mention that Hijack copies her own ultimate.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30s and steals Vanguard's Edge — the terrain wall that blocks paths and dashes gets turned on Irelia.
audit.corrected: Level 6 now names the Hijack theft; first item is anti-heal versus Kingslayer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Page repeatedly tells you to 'W the burst'. Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage only; Sylas's Chain Lash, Kingslayer and Petricite Burst are magic.
audit.why: Riot's own W text: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Flawless Duet is the real answer — it stuns and grounds, and grounding shuts off Abscond/Abduct.
audit.corrected: W-blocks-burst claims replaced; Flawless Duet grounding Abscond stated as the decisive interaction.

edits.after: Ahead, deny the heal: crash the wave so Kingslayer only hits minions, and hold Flawless Duet for his Abscond every time.
